a2-16-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Tomorrow's Letter
a2-16-01.scenario: At Carlos and Meg's flat in Hanoi, Meg asks what you are going to do tomorrow. You are going to write a letter.
a2-16-01.prompt: Tell Meg that you are going to write a letter tomorrow.
cues: Say what you are going to do
a2-16-01.target: Mañana voy a escribir una carta.
a2-16-01.english: Tomorrow I am going to write a letter.
a2-16-01.canDo: I can say what I am going to do using ir a + infinitive.

a2-16-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Yesterday and Last Year
a2-16-02.scenario: At the language exchange in Hanoi, Lucía asks what you did yesterday and when you finished your trip. You wrote a letter yesterday and finished the trip last year.
a2-16-02.prompt: Tell Lucía that you wrote a letter yesterday and that you finished the trip last year.
cues: Say when you finished the trip
a2-16-02.target: Ayer escribí una carta. Terminé el viaje el año pasado.
a2-16-02.english: Yesterday I wrote a letter. I finished the trip last year.
a2-16-02.canDo: I can use the pretérito indefinido to say what happened.

a2-16-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Past and Next
a2-16-03.scenario: At the language exchange, Daniela asks what happened and what you are going to do now. You wrote a letter and you are going to keep it.
a2-16-03.prompt: Tell Daniela that you wrote a letter and that you are going to keep it.
cues: Say what you are going to do with it
a2-16-03.target: Escribí una carta y voy a guardarla.
a2-16-03.english: I wrote a letter and I am going to keep it.
a2-16-03.canDo: I can contrast what happened with what you are going to do next.

a2-16-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Goals for Next Year
a2-16-04.scenario: At Carlos and Meg's flat, Kaylee asks about your goals for next year. You are going to learn Spanish and travel.
a2-16-04.prompt: Tell Kaylee that you are going to learn Spanish and travel next year.
cues: Say what you are going to learn
Say what else you are going to do next year
a2-16-04.target: El próximo año voy a aprender español y a viajar.
a2-16-04.english: Next year I am going to learn Spanish and travel.
a2-16-04.canDo: I can talk about my future plans and goals using ir a + infinitive.

a2-16-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Letter Box
a2-16-05.scenario: At Carlos and Meg's flat, Meg asks what you did with your letter and what you are going to do with it. You wrote it, put it in the box and you are going to open it next year.
a2-16-05.prompt: Tell Meg that you wrote a letter and kept it in the box, and that you are going to open it next year.
cues: Say what you wrote and where you kept it
Say what you are going to do next year
a2-16-05.target: Escribí una carta y la guardé en la caja. Voy a abrirla el próximo año.
a2-16-05.english: I wrote a letter and kept it in the box. I am going to open it next year.
a2-16-05.canDo: I can recount past events and describe future plans in a short narrative.

a2-16-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Plans and Past Events
a2-16-consolidation.scenario: At the language exchange, Lauren asks what you did yesterday and what you are going to do next year. You wrote a letter yesterday and next year you are going to travel.
a2-16-consolidation.prompt: Tell Lauren that you wrote a letter yesterday and that you are going to travel next year.
cues: Say what you are going to do next year
a2-16-consolidation.target: Ayer escribí una carta. El próximo año voy a viajar.
a2-16-consolidation.english: Yesterday I wrote a letter. Next year I am going to travel.
a2-16-consolidation.canDo: I can use ir a + infinitive and the pretérito indefinido to talk about plans and past events.
